notes: Version 1.0.250 — new report skins, thumbnail gallery, video and RAW thumbnails, watermark, PDF report.
changelog: New report skins (Modern, Hero, Minimal, Brand) with tiles, rings or pills for statistics — also in the .acerep client report.

Fixed .acerep client report: the .roa selection now marks only the chosen folders in PC-3000, also when the .acerep was exported for selected folders only (previously the whole drive or whole folders could be selected).
Thumbnail gallery view in the report (List / Gallery, S/M/L size).
Thumbnails from RAW photos (from the JPG preview stored in the file) and videos (5-frame strip, animated in the report).
Fast thumbnails without verification: only the beginning of RAW files is read; with verification on, large files take longer. New "Include RAW photos" option to skip RAW files.
Watermark on thumbnails: lab logo or any image; partner reports use the partner's logo, reports without lab data a text watermark.
One-page PDF report for the client (also without lab data and for a partner, optionally in ZIP); can be turned off in Settings.
HEIC/HEIF structure check in Content Analysis; search across all partitions in the report.

Fixes: crashes on damaged videos, settings not always remembered, size sliders in new skins; reports without verification show only file totals; messages after generating thumbnails follow the app language.
